title: Villains Night
intro: [mischievously] Welcome in to a very WICKED episode of Disney Jeopardy! Tonight the bad guys finally get their moment in the spotlight... [evil laugh] so grab your poisoned apples and keep one eye on your score, because these villains do NOT play fair.

art.prompt: A grand gothic villain's lair at midnight: a green-flamed stone hall with a spinning wheel, a glowing poisoned red apple on a pedestal, a bubbling cauldron and an ornate magic mirror, purple and acid-green light, swirling smoke. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Mistress of All Evil
categories.intro: [excited] We kick things off with Sleeping Beauty, the 1959 classic. Try not to doze off, or a certain horned lady might take it personally.

art.prompt: A dark thorny castle on a jagged mountain under a stormy green sky, a single spinning wheel glowing in a high tower window, a raven silhouette circling. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This horned evil fairy curses baby Aurora after she is not invited to the royal christening.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Maleficent. Lesson learned, kids: always invite the evil fairy. It saves everyone sixteen years of trouble.

clues.clue: Aurora is cursed to prick her finger on the spindle of one of these before the sun sets on her 16th birthday.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a spinning wheel. [laughs] King Stefan had every one in the kingdom burned, which honestly seems like a lot of work for one bad party.

clues.clue: To keep Aurora hidden in the forest cottage, the three good fairies raise her under this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Briar Rose. Sixteen years in a cottage with no magic allowed. Have you seen that birthday cake? [gasps] Yikes.

clues.clue: Prince Phillip rides to the rescue on this trusty horse, who was promised extra oats and carrots.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Samson. Phillip took those carrots back after a dunk in the creek. [sarcastic] Rude! Philippe, Maximus and Khan are horses from other films.

clues.clue: The music of Sleeping Beauty is adapted from the ballet by this Russian composer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tchaikovsky. Once Upon a Dream is built on a waltz from his 1890 ballet. Not bad for a guy who never got a Disney Plus residual.

categories.title: Bad to the Bone
categories.intro: [mischievously] Next up, a category about the meanest, greenest and most fashionable baddies Disney has to offer. It is called Bad to the Bone.

art.prompt: A villain's dressing table lit by candlelight: a black feather boa, a cobra-headed golden staff, a bubbling potion vial and a cracked crystal ball, dramatic red and purple shadows. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: In 101 Dalmatians, this fur-loving villain wants to turn the puppies into a spotted coat.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cruella de Vil. If she doesn't scare you, no evil thing will. And that driving? Absolutely villainous.

clues.clue: Jafar's final wish makes him the most powerful being on Earth, one of these, which sadly comes with a lamp.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a genie. Phenomenal cosmic powers, itty bitty living space. [laughs] Iago gets dragged in too, poor guy.

clues.clue: This smooth-talking voodoo man in The Princess and the Frog has friends on the other side.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Dr. Facilier, also known as the Shadow Man. Pro tip: never shake hands with a guy whose shadow moves on its own.

clues.clue: Judge Claude Frollo is the villain of this 1996 Disney animated film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Hunchback of Notre Dame. [chuckles] His song Hellfire is maybe the darkest villain number Disney ever made. Not exactly a cupcake.

clues.clue: This skeletal villain hunts for the title object in Disney's 1985 film The Black Cauldron.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Horned King, voiced by John Hurt. The film was so dark it was the first Disney animated feature rated PG.

categories.title: Wicked Wardrobes
categories.intro: Time for Color Palettes, villain edition. [chuckles] I will show you the colors of a baddie's outfit, and you name the fashion criminal.

art.prompt: A spooky haute couture atelier: dress forms draped in black, crimson, deep purple and gold fabrics, fabric swatches pinned on a board, moody spotlight. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Name the villain wearing these colors. Hint: she has eight arms and a deal for you.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Ursula. Lavender skin, black gown, golden shell necklace. Ariel's voice is in there somewhere.

clues.clue: Name the villain wearing these colors. Hint: he carries a cobra staff.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jafar. [laughs] Black and crimson robes and a turban so tall it needs its own zip code.

clues.clue: Name the villain wearing these colors. Hint: nobody fights like him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Gaston. Red tunic, yellow collar, black tights, brown boots. He uses antlers in all of his decorating.

clues.clue: Name the villain wearing these colors.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hades. [chuckles] Grey skin, a black toga and hair made of blue fire. When he gets mad, that blue turns orange real fast.

clues.clue: Name the villain wearing these colors.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain Hook. Red coat with gold trim, a white cravat and rose colored pants. Tick tock, that was a tough one.

categories.title: Grim Grinning Ghosts
categories.intro: Now we head to the parks for the spookiest house on the block. It is all about the Haunted Mansion. Your Doom Buggy awaits.

art.prompt: A creepy antebellum-style haunted manor on a hill at night, glowing windows, a hearse and crooked gravestones, translucent blue wisps drifting through the trees. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Doom Buggies carry you through this spooky Liberty Square attraction at Magic Kingdom.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion. Welcome, foolish mortals. Please keep your hands, arms and ectoplasm inside the buggy.

clues.clue: According to the Ghost Host, the mansion is home to this many happy haunts, with room for one more.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 999 happy haunts. There is always room for a thousand. Any volunteers? No? [laughs] Okay.

clues.clue: This fortune teller's head floats inside a crystal ball during the seance.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Madame Leota. Rap on a table, it's time to respond. Little Leota says goodbye at the end of the ride.

clues.clue: This Wild West spin on the Haunted Mansion sits in Frontierland at Disneyland Paris.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phantom Manor, overlooking the town of Thunder Mesa. [chuckles] Mystic Manor is the Hong Kong cousin with no ghosts at all.

clues.clue: This hat-toting ghost vanished from Disneyland's Haunted Mansion soon after its 1969 opening and finally returned in 2015.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hatbox Ghost. His head trick did not work well in 1969, so he disappeared for 46 years. Talk about a long coffee break.

categories.title: Villainous Voices
categories.intro: [excited] The Club DJ members picked this one. Listen to an iconic villain line and tell me who said it. No evil laughing until the end, please.

art.prompt: A vintage microphone on a stage bathed in green and purple spotlight, curling smoke forming a sinister grin shape in the air, velvet curtains. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which villain said this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Evil Queen from Snow White. Fun fact, she never says mirror mirror. It is magic mirror. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
clues.quote: Magic mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all?

clues.clue: Which villain said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Queen of Hearts from Alice in Wonderland. [laughs] Painting the roses red sounds like a lot less work than losing your head.

clues.clue: Which villain said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Scar, voiced by Jeremy Irons. [sighs] Saddest two seconds in Disney history, and you all know exactly which scene I mean.

clues.clue: Which villain said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yzma from The Emperor's New Groove. [dramatic] Wrong lever! Why do we even have that lever?

clues.clue: Which villain said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Shan Yu, the Hun leader from Mulan. The answer was one, by the way. One man. [sighs] Grim stuff.
clues.quote: How many men does it take to deliver a message?
